evidenceRequirements: Freeze case, protocol, adapter, prompt, tools and schema hashes before root approval and before transport.
Transmit only synthetic, restaurantId, demoNow and message. All IDs, expectations, provenance labels and run-order labels remain local.
Preserve every raw response, tool call/result, usage/reservation, failure, original input and resulting structured proposal.
Verify read-only store state before any local adoption probe. Use a separate fresh store for each probe and retain its before/after state and actual error.
Report low/high field-level results, critical omissions, unsupported claims, unknown handling, actual adoption outcome, latency and reported tokens/cost separately.
Stop the entire remaining queue on protocol, transport or budget failure. Semantic failure alone does not trigger a retry or skip later runs.
All completed and incomplete outcomes remain part of the final report. Never compare a completed arm with a missing paired arm as a reasoning win.
